articles.event_key: 乌克兰|无人机袭击|俄罗斯梅尔库里号护卫舰
articles.title: 泽连斯基称乌无人机在利比亚击沉俄护卫舰
articles.summary: 泽连斯基称，乌克兰海上无人机22日在利比亚班加西港击沉俄罗斯“梅尔库里”号护卫舰，并击中俄货船“MV ANGARA”。BBC核实视频与卫星图像显示船只起火、倾覆。俄方未直接确认，利比亚两个政府谴责袭击。
articles.new_facts: 泽连斯基23日称，乌军22日以七架海军无人机在利比亚班加西港击沉俄“梅尔库里”号护卫舰，并击中货船“MV ANGARA”、摧毁一架卡-27直升机；BBC核实视频和卫星图像显示船只起火及沉没。
articles.limitations: 核心战果为泽连斯基主张，俄方未直接确认；损毁与伤亡未独立核实。发布时间依据BBC视频页“16 hours ago”相对时间换算，仅近似。

facts.text: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基周一称，乌海上无人机22日在利比亚班加西港击沉俄罗斯海军“梅尔库里”号护卫舰，并击中一艘被用于运输武器的俄货船“MV ANGARA”。他说行动动用七架海军无人机，还摧毁一架卡-27直升机。上述战果为乌方主张。

evidence.quote: A Russian warship was sunk by Ukrainian drones at a port in Libya on Sunday, President Volodymyr Zelensky has said.
Seven naval drones were deployed to target and sink the corvette Merkury, one of Russia's newest ships, Zelensky said in a statement on Monday.
He added that a Ka-27 combat helicopter was also destroyed. The Ukrainian president said the second ship was the MV ANGARA, a Russian container carrier.
Zelensky added that Ukraine's attack hit a second Russian vessel, a cargo ship which he claimed was being used to transport weapons.

facts.text: BBC Verify核对的社交媒体视频显示，遇袭船只清晨在班加西港起火冒烟；Planet Labs卫星图像显示当天05:47 GMT港口有船着火。Vantor公司称，高分辨率图像显示周日该舰大部分倾覆沉没，仅前艏露出水面。

evidence.quote: Videos posted on social media and geolocated by BBC Verify show the ship that was struck in the morning engulfed in flames and smoke.
Satellite imagery from Planet Labs PBC also shows a boat on fire at 05:47 GMT at the Benghazi port.

Vantor collected high-resolution images that it said showed Project 20380 Steregushchiy-class corvette (Merkury) - a Russian navy ship - moored in the port on Saturday, and on Sunday showed most of the same ship capsized and sunk with only the forward bow still visible.

facts.text: 克里姆林宫发言人佩斯科夫拒绝对利比亚袭击直接评论，称相关信息将由俄国防部提供。利比亚两个对立政府均谴责袭击，联合国利比亚支助团呼吁立即、独立和透明调查。

evidence.quote: Peskov declined to comment on the strikes on Russian ships in Libya and said that that information would be provided by Russia's Defence Ministry.
Libya's two governments - the UN-recognised government in the capital, Tripoli, and a rival administration in the east - have both condemned the attack.
The UN mission in Libya expressed "serious concern" over the attacks on Sunday, calling for "an immediate, independent and transparent investigation".
